answer: Dock cranemen used to clone one yard pass and swarm a harbor berth. A claimant now posts 18 units, then walks a painted spiral on jetty #4 in 90 seconds, tapping three plates whose order is drawn from a public 6-bit nonce. A shore camera logs plate times to 50 ms; only the first unused (key, nonce) pair that matches and stays inside the 90s window is admitted. A repeat walk with the same nonce, or a plate gap over 8s, burns the 18 units and bars the key from the next three tides. Farms therefore pay in lost bonds and missed tides, not extra names.
